learning_outcomes: Name the four body parts (head, mouth, eyes, nose) by pointing to them on command.
Repeat the sentence pattern "This is my ___" after the teacher.

activities.title: Welcome Circle Time 5 min
activities.content:
• Welcome children with a smiling face.
• Say: Good morning, everyone!
• Guide the learners to respond: Good morning, Teacher!
• Introduce yourself to the pupils. Tell them your name.
• Say: In this class, you will learn how to speak English.
• Say: Look at me! I am touching my HEAD. Now you touch your head!
• Children: [Respond with actions]
• Say: What other body parts can you touch?
• Children: Respond with actions / words in any language.

activities.title: Song and Warm-Up 5 min
activities.content:
• Say: In this class, we will learn many 
songs in English.
• Say: We have a new song called Head, 
Shoulders, Knees and Toes! Listen first 
and watch my actions.
• Say the words one line at a time. Children repeat after each line.
• Sing each line slowly and clearly, using gestures and touching body parts. 
• Sing all verses. Children perform the full song with actions.
• Say: What did we just sing about?
• Children: Name the topic or vocabulary words from the song in any language.
• Say: Excellent!

activities.title: Vocabulary Introduction 10 min
activities.content:
• Hold up the HEAD picture card. Touch your own head clearly.
• Say: This is my HEAD. Say "head".
• Children: "Head."
• Say: Touch your head! (Children touch their heads.)
Song: Head, Shoulders, Knees and Toes
Head, shoulders, knees and toes, knees and toes, 
x 2
And eyes and ears and mouth and nose,
Head, shoulders, knees and toes, knees and toes!

• Hold up the MOUTH flashcard. Point to your mouth.
• Say: This is my MOUTH. Say: "Mouth".
• Children: "Mouth."
• Hold up EYES and NOSE cards in the same way.
• Say: Now repeat after me: "This is my nose." Touch your nose and say it!
• Children: "This is my nose!"
• Repeat with the other body parts.

activities.title: Body Parts Pointing Game 7 min
activities.content:
• Say: We are going to play a pointing game! When I call a body part, you touch it!
• Say: Touch your HEAD! (Children touch their heads.)
• Say: Touch your NOSE! (Children touch their noses.)
• Increase the speed. Mix the order.
• Say: Now I will say the sentence,  you touch and repeat: "This is my head".
• Children: This is my head! (touching)
• Call on 2-3 children to be the "teacher" and call out parts for classmates.

lessons.homework:
Tonight, touch your head, mouth, eyes, and nose for someone at home and 
say: "This is my ___!"
• Say: Goodbye, everyone! See you next time!
• Children: Goodbye, teacher! See you next time!

activities.title: Story Read Aloud  — First Reading 7 min
activities.content:
Before Reading
• Say: Story time! Our story today is called 'Look at Me!'. Listen carefully.
• Go round the class and show the picture of the story from the picture book.
• Say: Look at the picture, what do you see? 
• Call 2-3 learners to tell the class what they see in the picture (children can use any language).
• Say: What do you think the story is about?"
• Call 2-3 learners to make predictions (children can use any language).
• Say: This story is about a girl who knows all her body parts. Watch and listen.
• Read the story aloud clearly and with expression. Point to each body part on your own 
face.
After Reading: 
• Say: Who stands in front of the 
class? (Binta.)
• Say: What does Binta touch on 
her face? (eyes, nose, mouth.)
• Children: Touch head, eyes, 
nose, mouth!

lessons.homework:
Retell the story we heard today to your family members.
• Say: Goodbye, everyone! See you next time!
• Children: Goodbye, teacher! See you next time!
Look at Me!"
Binta stands in front of the class.
She touches her head. "This is my head," she says.
She opens her eyes wide. "These are my eyes."
She touches her nose. "This is my nose!"
She touches her mouth. "This is my mouth."
"Well done, Binta!" says her teacher. "You know your body!"

activities.content:
